summary.zh: Navo是基于Flutter与TDLib开发的独立非官方Telegram跨平台客户端，支持Android、iOS、Windows、macOS四大主流平台，用户可使用现有Telegram账号登录，实现多端消息同步，提供接近原生的即时通讯使用体验。
summary.en: Navo is an independent unofficial Telegram cross-platform client built with Flutter and TDLib, supporting Android, iOS, Windows and macOS. Users can log in with their existing Telegram accounts to sync messages across devices, delivering a near-native instant messaging experience.

metadata.description: 一款高性能、现代化支持的全栈多源影视采集聚合系统，用于搭建自己的私人影视库，支持Tvbox与Ecohub原生应用

summary.zh: EcoHub是基于Go与Next.js开发的高性能全栈多源影视聚合自托管系统，支持多源采集自动化管理，可快速搭建私人影视库，兼容TVBox、鸿蒙及安卓客户端，提供Docker一键部署与可视化管理后台，适用于影视爱好者自建私有观影平台场景。
summary.en: EcoHub is a high-performance full-stack multi-source video aggregation self-hosted system built with Go and Next.js. It supports automated multi-source collection and management, enabling users to quickly build private video libraries. It is compatible with TVBox, HarmonyOS and Android clients, offers one-click Docker deployment and a visual management backend, and is suitable for video enthusiasts to build private viewing platforms.

metadata.name: edgeever

summary.en: EdgeEver is an open-source, AI-native knowledge base and Evernote alternative with native MCP support. It enables zero-cost deployment on Cloudflare's free tier or via Docker, retains the classic three-pane note layout, features a fully open-source stack for self-hosting, integrates AI Agents, and delivers a lightweight, smooth experience for cross-device knowledge management and efficient note-taking.

It can simulate Zhang Xuefeng's speaking style to provide practical decision suggestions for college entrance examination application, postgraduate exam and career planning, serving as a runnable thinking framework rather than a simple quote collection, and supports multiple AI runtimes.

metadata.description: an AI Github Rlease Tracker Powered by Cloudflare

summary.:: GitPush是基于Cloudflare生态的AI GitHub Release追踪工具，可监控指定仓库的版本更新，借助DeepSeek R1自动生成更新摘要并通过邮件推送。依托Cloudflare Workers、Workflows等无服务器服务实现，无需本地部署，支持定时/手动触发，适用于开发者追踪开源项目动态、项目发布提醒等场景。
summary.en: GitPush is an AI-powered GitHub Release Tracker built on Cloudflare's ecosystem. It monitors specified repositories for version updates, uses DeepSeek R1 to auto-generate update summaries, and delivers notifications via email. Powered by serverless services like Cloudflare Workers and Workflows, it requires no local deployment, supports scheduled/manual triggers, and is ideal for developers tracking open-source updates and release alerts.

summary.en: x-ui-pro is an open-source one-click deployment tool designed for anti-censorship proxy services on Linux servers. It integrates mainstream proxy components including x-ui, v2rayA, WARP, Psiphon and Tor, implements multi-protocol reverse proxy supporting WebSocket, GRPC, HttpUpgrade and XHTTP via nginx, supports Cloudflare CDN integration, automatic SSL renewal, fake website camouflage and multi-domain management, enabling users to quickly build stable proxy services to bypass internet restrictions.

summary.en: An open-source, self-hostable all-in-one IP toolbox integrating over 20 features including multi-source IP lookup, WebRTC/DNS leak detection, speed test, MTR routing, global connectivity check, and browser fingerprinting. summary.en: Xinghai Music Source is a custom audio source plugin for LX Music, aggregating public APIs like GDAPI and ChKSz to support multi-bitrate music acquisition from 5 major platforms including NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Kuwo Music, Kugou Music and Migu Music. summary.en: XiaoZhi is an ESP32-based edge AI Agent leveraging the MCP protocol, integrated with large models such as Qwen and DeepSeek. It supports offline voice wake-up, full-duplex voice interaction, device-side and cloud-side MCP capability expansion, and is compatible with multiple ESP32 development boards, enabling rapid development of intelligent hardware terminals with voice interaction and device control functions.

metadata.name: Median

summary.en: Median is an extremely lightweight local-first Android browser with a mere 200KB installer. Built natively in Java on top of Android System WebView, it has no ad or telemetry SDKs, and provides features like ad blocking, local encrypted password vault, userscript support, and offline reading, with all user data stored locally by default for privacy-focused browsing.

summary.zh: Argosbx是面向小白的一键无交互代理部署工具，整合Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核，支持VPS、Docker等多环境部署，内置15种WARP出站组合与5套CDN优选方案，覆盖Naiveproxy、Hysteria2等12+主流代理协议，无需域名即可快速搭建，解决IP被封、流媒体解锁痛点。

metadata.name: whistle
metadata.description: HTTP, HTTP2, HTTPS, Websocket debugging proxy

summary.en: Whistle is a Node.js-based cross-platform network packet capture and debugging proxy tool. It supports capturing and modifying requests and responses for protocols including HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, WebSocket and TCP, and provides built-in debugging features like remote DOM inspection and request replay. With rule-based configuration and plugin extension support, it is widely applied in frontend development, API debugging and online issue troubleshooting.

It supports multi-account login and highly customizable settings, solving pain points of limited official features and complicated proxy setup, suitable for diverse scenarios, offering Android users a more flexible, privacy-focused Telegram experience.

summary.en: This repository is a curated list of open-source tools in the Cloudflare ecosystem, targeting indie developers. It collects lightweight tools for image hosting, blogs, short links, object storage and more, helping developers improve development efficiency and reduce deployment costs. It offers multilingual versions and online navigation, and is continuously updated.

metadata.name: Sandboxie

summary.en: Sandboxie is an open-source system-level sandbox isolation tool for Windows, available in Plus and Classic editions. It creates isolated virtual environments to run or install programs without modifying the host system, registry or disk data, supports parallel multi-sandbox operation, and is applicable to untrusted program testing, secure surfing and malware defense. The Plus edition features a modern Qt-based UI and enhanced functions like snapshot management.

metadata.name: proxypin

summary.en: ProxyPin is an open-source, free cross-platform HTTP/HTTPS traffic capture tool built with Flutter, supporting Windows, Mac, Android, iOS and Linux. It supports Flutter app traffic capture and QR code quick proxy connection, and offers features like traffic filtering, script processing, request rewriting/blocking/decryption and HAR export, suitable for mobile and Web development debugging as well as network troubleshooting.

summary.en: N3RD is a development project targeting Connected TV (CTV) scenarios, focusing on the needs of smart TV application development and ecosystem adaptation, providing development tools and capability support for relevant developers to facilitate efficient deployment of CTV ecosystem applications.

metadata.name: adblockfilters

summary.en: This project automatically aggregates ad-blocking filter rules from multiple upstream sources, updates every 8 hours on schedule, removes invalid domains via DNS resolution verification, and outputs rule sets compatible with tools like AdGuard and DNSMasq, with multi-line acceleration links and China-only lite versions provided to solve the pain point of manual ad rule synchronization.

summary.en: DouK-Downloader is a Python-based dual-platform tool for Douyin/TikTok, supporting high-definition video download, full data collection, and live stream link extraction. It features a WebUI interface, batch/incremental download, multi-format data export, proxy access, and clipboard monitoring, and can be deployed on servers for content backup and data research.

summary.en: MediaGo is a cross-platform video downloader designed for sniffing and grabbing m3u8/HLS streams, with compatibility for over 1000 mainstream video sites including Bilibili, YouTube, Twitter/X and Instagram. It offers flexible deployment options including desktop apps and one-line Docker deployment, equipped with built-in browser extension, open HTTP API, local format conversion, and AI assistant integration to enable voice-controlled download, eliminating the need for packet capture, browser extension configuration or complex command-line operations.

It supports recording and danmaku capture for 19 mainstream live platforms, features zero-disk recording and uploading, multi-account management, WebUI visual monitoring, and 24/7 unattended operation. It also supports CLI encapsulation and AI Agent integration, suitable for live content reposting and creator auto-upload scenarios.

metadata.name: anti-AD
metadata.description: 致力于成为中文区命中率最高的广告过滤列表，实现精确的广告屏蔽和隐私保护。anti-AD 现已支持 AdGuardHome，dnsmasq，Surge，Pi-Hole，Clash, mihomo，smartdns，sing-box 等网络组件。完全兼容常见的广告过滤工具所支持的各种广告过滤列表格式

summary.en: anti-AD is a high-accuracy ad blocking and privacy protection tool tailored for Chinese users, working at the DNS resolution layer. It supports over 10 mainstream network components including AdGuardHome, dnsmasq, Surge and Pi-Hole, is compatible with common ad filter list formats, and can block ad domains, built-in device ads and privacy-tracking sites. It improves blocking accuracy by merging and deduplicating upstream rules and optimizing matching logic.

summary.en: 1Panel is an open-source, all-in-one Linux server management and lightweight AI management platform, serving over 2.5 million self-hosters globally. It provides full lifecycle AI agent management, visual server operations, one-click website deployment, and a built-in open-source app store, with multi-language support, significantly lowering the threshold for server management and AI implementation.

metadata.description: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。

summary.zh: RSSPush 是开源 RSS 变动监测工具，可自动追踪订阅源更新并推送至微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十个消息通道，支持 Docker 一键部署、内置 RSSHub 源库、关键词黑白名单过滤、内容自动翻译，满足个人与团队的多平台内容聚合通知需求。
summary.en: RSSPush is an open-source RSS change monitoring tool that automatically tracks subscribed feed updates and pushes them to dozens of messaging channels including WeChat, Telegram and Discord. It supports one-click Docker deployment, built-in RSSHub source library, keyword blacklist/whitelist filtering, and automatic content translation, meeting the multi-platform content aggregation notification needs of individuals and teams.

metadata.name: WebMonitor
metadata.description: 实时监控网页变化，并发送通知（Monitor web page changes in real time and send notifications）

summary.zh: WebMonitor是一款轻量化网页变更监控工具，可实时监测网页内容变化并推送多渠道通知，适用于舆情监控、竞品价格追踪、RSS更新提醒等场景；技术亮点包括支持PhantomJS抓取异步网页、XPath/CSS选择器与JsonPath多维度数据提取、可视化配置及Docker一键部署。
summary.en: WebMonitor is a lightweight web change monitoring tool that detects webpage content changes in real time and delivers multi-channel notifications. It applies to scenarios like public opinion monitoring, competitor price tracking, and RSS update alerts. Key technical highlights include PhantomJS-based asynchronous webpage crawling, multi-dimensional data extraction via XPath/CSS selectors and JsonPath, visual configuration, and one-click Docker deployment.

metadata.name: FileCentipede
metadata.description: Cross-platform internet upload/download manager for HTTP(S), FTP(S), SSH, magnet-link, BitTorrent, m3u8, ed2k, and online videos.  WebDAV client, FTP client, SSH client.

summary.en: FileCentipede is an all-in-one cross-platform internet file upload/download manager supporting over 10 protocols including HTTP(S), FTP, SSH, magnet links, BitTorrent and m3u8. It integrates WebDAV, FTP, SSH clients and browser extensions to download encrypted online videos, and offers auxiliary tools like HTTP requester, file merger and encoders, featuring high speed, strong customizability and user-friendly design.

metadata.description: ShareX is a free and open-source application that enables users to capture or record any area of their screen with a single keystroke. It also supports uploading images, text, and various file types to a wide range of destinations.

summary.en: ShareX is a free, open-source lightweight Windows desktop tool for screen capture, recording and file sharing. It supports full/region screenshot, GIF/video recording, OCR text recognition, automatic file upload, customizable hotkeys and workflows, with no ads and privacy-focused design, serving developers, content creators and power users for daily capture, recording and sharing needs.

summary.zh: v2rayN 是一款开源跨平台 GUI 代理客户端，支持 Xray、sing-box 等主流代理核心，兼容 Windows、Linux、macOS 三大操作系统及多 CPU 架构，提供 GPG 签名校验保障安装包安全，是网络代理场景下的高人气实用工具。
summary.en: v2rayN is an open-source cross-platform GUI proxy client that supports mainstream proxy cores like Xray and sing-box. It is compatible with Windows, Linux and macOS, as well as multiple CPU architectures, and provides GPG signature verification to ensure installer security, making it a popular practical tool for network proxy scenarios.

metadata.name: v2ray-heroku
metadata.description: 用于在 Heroku 上部署 V2Ray WebSocket。

summary.zh: 本仓库提供Heroku平台一键部署V2Ray WebSocket代理的方案，适用于轻量代理场景，自动同步最新V2Ray版本，支持Cloudflare接入优化访问速度，合理使用可避免资源占用导致的封号，另有VLESS协议分支可选。
summary.en: This repository provides an out-of-the-box one-click deployment solution for V2Ray WebSocket proxy on the Heroku platform, suitable for lightweight proxy scenarios for individual users to access restricted content. It automatically syncs to the latest V2Ray version, supports Cloudflare integration to optimize access speed, and avoids account bans caused by excessive resource usage when used properly, with an optional VLESS protocol branch available.
